name: Integration lab
description: A private workspace for trying connected tools and seeing what each one can do.
instructions: For the Integration lab template, keep backend/main.py as the router entrypoint and move provider calls into focused backend services when extending the lab. Preserve the /catalog and /run backend endpoints so the frontend stays metadata-driven. Prefer read-only test actions, clearly mark side-effect actions, and surface provider errors as JSON instead of throwing opaque frontend failures. Use hangarkit.integrations.log_platform for Log Platform searches; pass env and region as search parameters rather than storing them as integration settings.
